artist.name: Sasha Alex Sloan
artist.short_description: Boston-born singer-songwriter known for intimate pop that explores relationships, family, self-image, and the discomforts of growing up.
artist.biography: Sasha Alex Sloan is an American singer-songwriter from the Boston area who records under a name different from the expanded name Alexandra Artourovna Yatchenko listed in AllMusic. In a 2020 interview, Sloan described learning piano as a child, writing early songs, and eventually moving to Los Angeles after signing a songwriting publishing deal. She first developed her career writing with and for other artists before releasing her own material. The 2019 single 'Dancing With Your Ghost' brought wider attention to her reflective style; Sloan has explained that its concept arose after a close family friend lost her husband. Her 2020 debut album 'Only Child' pushed beyond conventional breakup songs into upbringing, family, vulnerability, body image, and existential questions. She supplied Apple Music with detailed, first-person commentary about the album, including how 'House With No Mirrors' came from a difficult moment involving her self-image and how 'Until It Happens to You' addresses the inability to comfort someone facing loss. In later years Sloan released 'I Blame the World' in 2022 and 'Me Again' in 2024, broadening a catalogue still strongly associated with unguarded writing. Afterglow groups her with emotional and confessional pop as an editorial classification rather than a claim about a single official genre.
